name: Foster-Powell

characteristics.housing_stock: 1920s-1940s bungalows and Craftsman cottages, some postwar ranches, increasing ADU and infill development
characteristics.transit_access: Good — frequent bus on Foster and Powell, close to future transit improvements on 82nd
characteristics.crime_trend: Improving — down 12% YoY, significant quality of life improvements on Foster corridor
characteristics.development_pipeline: Foster Rd streetscape improvements complete, new restaurants and shops on Foster, continued infill housing

investment_thesis: Rapid gentrification along Foster Rd corridor has transformed this neighborhood. Higher entry point but strong demand and fast appreciation. Best suited for light-touch rehabs on the remaining unrenovated bungalows — the spread between unrenovated and renovated is significant. Walkability and restaurant/bar scene attract young professionals. Tighter margins than Lents or Cully but lower risk.
risk_factors: Gentrification well underway — fewer deep discount opportunities remain
Higher entry price reduces margin on flips
Competition from other investors and owner-occupants
Some parcels near Powell Blvd have noise and traffic concerns
Market correction sensitivity — higher-priced areas may see larger corrections
